'''The Power Of One: The Pokémon 2000 Movie Special''' was a television special that aired on {{wp|The WB}} network in the {{pmin|United States}} on July 16, 2000<ref>[https://www.warnerbros.com/news/press-releases/power-one-pok%C3%A9mon-2000-movie-special-offers-first-look-new-movie-soundtrack-plus/ ''"The Power Of One: The Pokémon 2000 Movie Special" Offers First Look At New Movie & Soundtrack'' - Warner Bros.] (retrieved May 26, 2020)</ref>. The TV special was created to promote the theatrical English dub release of the second [[Pokémon movie]], ''[[M02|Pokémon the Movie 2000: The Power of One]]''. The WB was the American home of {{aniseries|PTS}} at the time, owned by [[Warner Bros.]], who was also distributing the film. The special was hosted by actor and comedian {{wp|Kel Mitchell}}<ref name="lostmedia">[https://lostmediawiki.com/The_Power_of_One:_The_Pokémon_2000_Movie_Special_(found_TV_special;_2000) ''The Power of One: The Pokémon 2000 Movie Special'' - Lost Media Wiki] (retrieved May 20, 2020)</ref>, and was directed by Richard Brian DiPirro<ref>[https://www.imdb.com/name/nm0228134/ ''Richard Dipirro'' - IMDb] (retrieved May 26, 2020)</ref>.

The special featured live performances of songs from [[Pokémon the Movie 2000 (soundtrack)|the movie's soundtrack]] and included segments that went behind-the-scenes on how the soundtrack's music was produced, with interviews of artists whose music was featured. Guest appearances included {{wp|Kobe Bryant}}, {{wp|Christina Aguilera}}, {{wp|'N Sync}}, and {{wp|David Gallagher}}, all of whom told inspirational stories centered around the theme of "the power of one".

The special only aired once and never saw commercial release on home media. The DVD release of ''Pokémon the Movie 2000: The Power of One'' contained segments from the special as bonus features.
